listenings.text: Sorry, sorry. Can you repeat everything, please? I did not understand. All of it, from the beginning. Sorry, it is my English. Maybe you can send me an email later?

Just two quick checks. Sorry, I didn't catch the number. Forty-eight? And the file comes to you by the tenth, is that right? Ralph signs it, doesn't he? Let me note that down. So, to summarize: forty-eight people, the file to you by the tenth, and Ralph signs from London.
